senses.gloss: m. (Infin. Hif. of סָתַר) ה׳ פנים (from Deut. XXXI, 18) hiding of face, divine anger, refusal to answer prayer.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 5a:18">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שאינו בה׳ פ׳ וכ׳</he> he who is not subject to the hiding of face (who does not suffer under general persecution) is none of them (not of Israelitish descent).
